articles.title: Week 16 fantasy football TE rankings: Best starts at tight end
articles.summary: The article analyzes Atlanta Falcons tight end Kyle Pitts' breakout performance in Week 15, highlighting the surprising delay in him achieving his widely recognized talent. Despite being in the NFL for nearly five seasons, Pitts' recent display of skill against Tampa finally met expectations, prompting questions about the reasons behind his prolonged wait to consistently perform at this high level.

articles.title: Week 16 fantasy WR rankings: Best starts at wide receiver
articles.summary: The 2025 NFL season features an inspiring comeback story from Tampa Bay Buccaneers wide receiver Mike Evans. He suffered a broken collarbone in Week 7, an injury typically career-threatening, but made a remarkable return to the field. His resilience and determination to overcome a significant setback highlight his dedication to professional sports, making his recovery a notable event in the league.

articles.title: Week 16 fantasy football RB rankings: Best starts at running back
articles.summary: In Week 15 of the fantasy football playoffs, the Jacksonville Jaguars secured a dominant victory, mauling the New York Jets with a score of 48-2. This significant win highlighted a common playoff phenomenon where a single player's outstanding performance was crucial in carrying their team to triumph. The lopsided result marked a memorable moment in the ongoing competition.

articles.title: AgustaWestland: Court orders Christian Michel's release from custody in ED case
articles.summary: A Delhi court has ordered the release of Christian James Michel from custody in a money laundering case filed by the Enforcement Directorate (ED). Michel, an alleged middleman, was arrested in connection with the AgustaWestland VVIP helicopter deal scam. This development marks a significant legal turn in the ongoing investigation into alleged irregularities in the high-profile defence procurement case.

articles.title: Russian attack on Ukraine’s Odesa kills at least 8 as peace talks lumber on
articles.summary: Russia conducted a ballistic missile strike on Odesa, Ukraine's strategic Black Sea port, resulting in at least eight deaths and 27 injuries. This attack highlights Moscow's intensified targeting of critical infrastructure in Ukraine. SSB aspirants should observe the persistent geopolitical tensions and the strategic importance of port cities in ongoing international conflicts.

articles.title: ISRO completes drogue parachute qualification tests for human spaceflight mission
articles.summary: ISRO successfully completed qualification tests for the drogue parachutes designed for its Gaganyaan crew module. This significant milestone marks crucial progress in India's ambitious human spaceflight mission, ensuring safe descent and recovery of astronauts. The rigorous testing validates critical technology for the upcoming crewed launch, bringing Gaganyaan closer to its operational phase.

articles.title: Russian Defence Ministry holds a briefing for military attachés of foreign states
articles.summary: General Valery Gerasimov, Chief of the General Staff and First Deputy Defence Minister of the Russian Federation, held a significant briefing on 18 December 2025. This event highlights high-level military communication and the strategic roles of top leadership within Russia's armed forces. For SSB aspirants, it exemplifies how senior officers manage defence posture and internal military affairs.
